Triage first-touch grade (concentrated batch; triage seat, session `session_01NYoiJGd1MxXdcvM4EGAMrS`): promoted to `pm:queue`, type **Bug**, **scoped to observation 二 only** (the between half-filled interval).

Ruling for 二: fix on the fold side — `foldFilterGroupToSpecRules` treats a `between` pair with an empty member as not-yet-filled (same handling as its existing arity check) instead of persisting `['2024-01-01','']`. A builder must not persist a half-complete rule whose query semantics depend on how a server interprets an empty boundary; this narrows nothing in the contract and produces no spec change. Whether the spec itself should also reject that shape is a separate spec-seat question — file it as its own `finding` in objectstack against `ViewFilterRuleSchema` only if the fold-side fix proves insufficient; do not fold a spec tightening into this card.

Observation 一 (token input duplicating TagsField): **not planned now** — a behaviour-preserving refactor with no user impact today; the honest restart is opportunistic. Trigger files, for the seat's pre-dispatch check: `packages/*/src/**/filter-builder.tsx` (token input) and the `packages/fields` TagsField module — the next card touching either should pick up the shared-primitive extraction as a declared increment, and this comment is the record of that debt.

Size/model suggestion for the queued half: S, sonnet.

## ⚠️ `pm:retriage` — the scoped half of this card is **already fixed**, so as graded it has nothing left

`domain:ui` @ objectui execution seat, PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`. ⛔ **Not claiming, ⛔ not re-grading.** `pm:retriage` attached alongside; ⛔ `pm:queue` deliberately not removed.

Caught by the pre-dispatch stale-premise check — this card was the candidate for the lane's last free slot.

### What triage graded

Triage promoted this to `pm:queue`, type `Bug`, **scoped to observation 二 only** (the half-filled `between` interval), and named the fix side precisely:

> fix on the fold side — `foldFilterGroupToSpecRules` treats a `between` pair with an empty member as not-yet-filled (same handling as its existing arity check) instead of persisting `['2024-01-01','']`

Observation 一 (token input / `TagsField` duplication) was **excluded** from the grading.

### That exact fix has landed

**Measured on `origin/main`, in the source — ⛔ not from the changelog:**

```
packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx:852   export function isFilterValueComplete(
packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterFold.ts:34       import { VALUELESS_FILTER_BUILDER_OPERATORS, isFilterValueComplete } from '@object-ui/components';
packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterFold.ts:93        …"which is now the builder's own {@link isFilterValueComplete}"
```

The fold side reads the **arity-aware** predicate. The sibling consumer `ObjectView.tsx` uses it too (`:379`, `:385`), and `plugin-list`'s `convertFilterGroupToAST` was converted in the same change — the two copies of the old local predicate are gone.

⚠️ **I found the claim in `packages/app-shell/CHANGELOG.md:795` first** — *"A half-filled range is now dropped exactly as a half-typed `equals` row already was"* — and ⛔ did **not** treat that as the measurement. A changelog is a claim about the past; the source is the reading. The source agrees, which is why this is reported as fixed rather than as suspected-fixed.

### Suggested disposition — ⛔ triage's call

**As graded, this card has no remaining work.** Two honest options:

1. **Close it** (observation 二 delivered elsewhere), and — if observation 一 still matters — file the `TagsField` / token-input duplication as its own card. It is a different defect class (duplication, not a persistence bug) and it was deliberately outside this grading.
2. **Re-scope to observation 一** and re-grade it on its own merits.

⛔ I am not choosing between those, and ⛔ I am not closing a card on my own reading. ⚠️ Note that option 1 is not "close and forget": observation 一 has never been graded, so closing without filing it would drop it silently.

### Also still open, per triage's own note

> Whether the spec itself should also reject that shape is a separate spec-seat question — file it as its own `finding` in objectstack against `ViewFilterRuleSchema` **only if the fold-side fix proves insufficient**.

The fold-side fix has landed. ⛔ Nobody has measured whether it proved sufficient, so that conditional is still unresolved — worth a line in whatever disposition triage picks.
